Claire — thanks again for the intro call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on timing for a potential POC and procurement: 

Summary of call:
- Use case: LumenAI will embed Redwood Inference for low-latency document summarization in your internal analyst tool.
- Expected first-phase volume: ~200k tokens/day, with burst windows during month-end reconciliation.
- Primary decision criteria: latency (p99 < 300ms), cost per token, data isolation for analyst uploads.

Asks / next steps:
1) Can you share the procurement contact (ticket intake/portal) and the PO timeline your ops team typically targets?
2) Security/legal: Claire, you mentioned SOC 2 and an IP clause for external vendor contracts — who should we loop in to start the security questionnaire and discuss standard redlines?
3) I'll send a draft SOW and our standard onboarding checklist (W9, insurance, contact for invoices). Any preferred invoice routing?

Attachments: LumenAI_vendor_intake_form.pdf (please complete and return)

If useful, I propose a 30-min follow-up next week with procurement + security to map the gating items. Available windows: Wed-Fri mornings PT.

Thanks — looking forward to progressing.

--
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
